newsitem.title: FRANCE: French left make up ground in election campaign.
newsitem.headline: French left make up ground in election campaign.

text.p: Following are the results of an opinion poll of voters' intentions ahead of the May 25/June 1 French parliamentary election.
The telephone poll of 1,002 adults aged 18 and over was conducted by IFOP on May 2 for Sunday's Journal du Dimanche and BFM radio and made public on May 3

IFOP said 22 per cent of those surveyed did not say how they would vote. In the survey, 64 percent said their party choice was definite while 36 percent said they could still change their voting plans.

In the last poll IFOP conducted on April 25, it found that two percent supported the extreme left, 10 percent favoured the Communists, 26 percent backed the Socialists, 6.5 percent would vote for ecologist candidates, 37 percent were supporters of the RPR/UDF and 2.5 percent supported other right-wing parties while the Front National had the backing of 16 percent.
The same poll gave the left between 219 and 245 seats and the centre right between 311 and 331 seats.
